name: Hand Stretch
description: Open, close and soften your hands.

steps.title: Open wide
steps.text: Spread your fingers as comfortably wide as you can, like a star.

steps.title: Soft fist
steps.text: Gently curl your fingers into a loose fist. Open and close slowly five times.

steps.title: Press and release
steps.text: Press your palms together in front of your chest for a few breaths, then let go and shake your hands loose. Move slowly and only as far as feels comfortable. Stop if anything hurts.
